title: Entering an Amendment Charge on a Vacation Package
content:
The amendment charge owed on a vacation package answers a change the operations desk has already approved against that package, and it is entered against the party as a whole. It falls to be entered on a package sold under any of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products once such a charge stands owed, and the figure entered is the amendment charge payable on that package.

## What the entry does

Entering the charge adds a single amendment-charge line to that package's ledger for the party as a whole, carrying the money charged, the calendar date it posted and the reason that the party's particulars were changed. The net money standing against the package rises by that amount, so the party's package statement shows the amendment itemised alongside their deposit and instalments.

## How the entry is made

The desk tool `charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d` is unlocked and then called by the agent. It is an agent's own tool and is not handed to the party.

## What it is given

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_package_id` | the internal reference number of the vacation package the amendment charge is being entered on, as carried on the package record returned by the vacation package lookup | an identifier |
| `amendment_charge_usd` | the money charged to the party for the amendment | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, with no currency symbol, thousands separator or sign; always a positive money value |

Neither parameter carries a set of fixed candidates: `bundle_package_id` is the package's own reference and `amendment_charge_usd` is a money value in the format above.

## What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the new package ledger line reference, the package the charge was entered on and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places. That sentence, carrying a ledger line reference, is what indicates the charge was entered; no other value is returned.
